role: The key of a section's mesh (lane/remesh): a 128-bit hash of every byte render_blocks.c's world accessors can read for a section (the cells within 3 blocks in x and z and 2 in y, the chunks' section masks, the height maps when a band is absent, the biomes, the camera cell, no_sky), the passes its cells are drawn in, and the band a section reads. raster.c keeps a stale section's mesh while its key holds.
notes: Not vanilla code: vanilla marks a renderer dirty and rebuilds it; a rebuild whose inputs hashed the same is the same bytes, so raster.c keeps the mesh (pipe_gate --mesh-check meshes every spared pass again and compares). Renderer state only, no statics; never in the tick.
